about_the_game:
Dive into the Original Soundtrack crafted by Floris Demandt, which provides Projected Dreams with its warm, playful and wonderfully dreamy nostalgic charm. We've packed this collection with every musical treasure you'll discover in the game - the beloved cassette recordings (complete with their authentic, lo-fi sound quality) to all the music from cutscenes and trailers, plus a special bonus track just for you!

Get ready to immerse yourself in the complete musical journey of Projected Dreams!

short_description: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.
